Eligibility of Tenderer : 1.The minimum number of years of general exprience of the tenderer in construction works shall be 05(five) years
2.The munumum specific exprience in similar works of at lest 01(one) contract of public (Gov. semi Gov. and Autonomous) builing
construction successfully completed within the last 05(five) Years in each with a value of at lest Tk 10(ten) lakh.
3.The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 25(twenty fuve) lakh over last 05(five Year) .
4.The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderer shall be Tk 7(seven)lakh.
5.Tender document containing insufficient/incomplete information will be rejected.
6.Furnishing of any false, Fake and forged document or information by a tender shall result in rejection of his tender and may lead
to forfeiture of tender Security and action against tender under reguler of PPA 200.
7.If queated rate is found more then 5% above or below Estimeted cost, Tender will be Non-responsive
